templates.name: Client controller
templates.description: ContextActionService input, lightweight tweened HUD and character lifecycle wiring.
templates.content:
--!strict
-- ClientController.client.lua (LocalScript, StarterPlayerScripts)
-- Input handling with ContextActionService, a lightweight HUD and a clean
-- character lifecycle. Pairs with RemoteBus for server communication.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local sharedFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Shared")
local RemoteBus = sharedFolder and sharedFolder:FindFirstChild("RemoteBus") and require(sharedFolder.RemoteBus) or nil

-- HUD -------------------------------------------------------------------------
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Name = "HUD"
screen.ResetOnSpawn = false
screen.IgnoreGuiInset = true
screen.Parent = playerGui

local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Name = "Status"
label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
label.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.95)
label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 36)
label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 18, 14)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 180, 41)
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
label.TextSize = 16
label.Text = "Ready"
label.Parent = screen
Instance.new("UICorner", label).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

local function flash(text: string)
	label.Text = text
	label.TextTransparency = 0
	TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(1.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { TextTransparency = 0.6 }):Play()
end

-- Input -----------------------------------------------------------------------
local function onInteract(_: string, state: Enum.UserInputState)
	if state ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
	end
	flash("Interact pressed")
	if RemoteBus then
		RemoteBus.Fire("Interact")
	end
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end

ContextActionService:BindAction("Interact", onInteract, true, Enum.KeyCode.E, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonX)
ContextActionService:SetTitle("Interact", "Use")
ContextActionService:SetPosition("Interact", UDim2.fromScale(0.72, 0.2))

-- Character lifecycle ---------------------------------------------------------
local function onCharacter(character: Model)
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
	flash(("Spawned - %d HP"):format(humanoid.MaxHealth))
	humanoid.Died:Once(function()
		flash("You died")
	end)
end

if player.Character then
	task.spawn(onCharacter, player.Character)
end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter)

-- Server pushes ---------------------------------------------------------------
if RemoteBus then
	RemoteBus.OnClientEvent("Notify", function(message: string)
		flash(tostring(message))
	end)
end

templates.name: PlayerData service
templates.description: DataStore profile service with defaults, exponential retries, autosave, BindToClose flush and leaderstats mirror.
templates.content:
--!strict
-- PlayerData.lua (ModuleScript, ServerScriptService/Services)
-- DataStore wrapper with defaults, retries, autosave, BindToClose flush and
-- a leaderstats mirror. Returns a service table compatible with ServerBootstrap.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local STORE_NAME = "PlayerData_v1"
local AUTOSAVE_SECONDS = 120
local MAX_RETRIES = 4

export type Profile = {
	Coins: number,
	Level: number,
	Inventory: { string },
	Version: number,
}

local DEFAULTS: Profile = {
	Coins = 0,
	Level = 1,
	Inventory = {},
	Version = 1,
}

local PlayerData = { Name = "PlayerData" }
local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore(STORE_NAME)
local profiles: { [Player]: Profile } = {}

local function deepCopy<T>(value: T): T
	if typeof(value) ~= "table" then
		return value
	end
	local copy = {}
	for k, v in value :: any do
		copy[k] = deepCopy(v)
	end
	return copy :: any
end

local function reconcile(data: any): Profile
	local profile = deepCopy(DEFAULTS)
	if typeof(data) == "table" then
		for key, default in DEFAULTS :: any do
			if data[key] ~= nil and typeof(data[key]) == typeof(default) then
				(profile :: any)[key] = data[key]
			end
		end
	end
	return profile
end

local function withRetry<T>(label: string, fn: () -> T): (boolean, T?)
	local delaySeconds = 1
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, result = pcall(fn)
		if ok then
			return true, result
		end
		warn(("[PlayerData] %s attempt %d failed: %s"):format(label, attempt, tostring(result)))
		task.wait(delaySeconds)
		delaySeconds *= 2
	end
	return false, nil
end

local function buildLeaderstats(player: Player, profile: Profile)
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "leaderstats"
	local coins = Instance.new("IntValue")
	coins.Name = "Coins"
	coins.Value = profile.Coins
	coins.Parent = folder
	local level = Instance.new("IntValue")
	level.Name = "Level"
	level.Value = profile.Level
	level.Parent = folder
	folder.Parent = player
end

function PlayerData.Get(player: Player): Profile?
	return profiles[player]
end

function PlayerData.Update(player: Player, mutator: (Profile) -> ())
	local profile = profiles[player]
	if not profile then
		return
	end
	mutator(profile)
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if stats then
		local coins = stats:FindFirstChild("Coins") :: IntValue?
		local level = stats:FindFirstChild("Level") :: IntValue?
		if coins then coins.Value = profile.Coins end
		if level then level.Value = profile.Level end
	end
end

local function save(player: Player)
	local profile = profiles[player]
	if not profile or RunService:IsStudio() and not game:GetService("RunService"):IsRunning() then
		return
	end
	withRetry("save " .. player.Name, function()
		store:UpdateAsync(("player_%d"):format(player.UserId), function()
			return profile
		end)
	end)
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	local ok, data = withRetry("load " .. player.Name, function()
		return store:GetAsync(("player_%d"):format(player.UserId))
	end)
	if not ok then
		player:Kick("Your data could not be loaded. Please rejoin in a moment.")
		return
	end
	local profile = reconcile(data)
	profiles[player] = profile
	buildLeaderstats(player, profile)
end

local function onPlayerRemoving(player: Player)
	save(player)
	profiles[player] = nil
end

function PlayerData:Init()
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onPlayerRemoving)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
	end
end

function PlayerData:Start()
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(AUTOSAVE_SECONDS)
			for player in profiles do
				task.spawn(save, player)
			end
		end
	end)
	game:BindToClose(function()
		for player in profiles do
			save(player)
		end
	end)
end

return PlayerData

templates.name: RemoteBus
templates.description: Declarative remotes with per-player rate limiting and payload validators; typed helpers for both sides.
templates.content:
--!strict
-- RemoteBus.lua (ModuleScript, ReplicatedStorage/Shared)
-- One place to declare remotes. Server side validates payload shapes and
-- rate-limits per player; client side gets typed helpers.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local FOLDER_NAME = "Remotes"
local RATE_LIMIT_PER_SECOND = 20

local RemoteBus = {}

local function folder(): Folder
	local existing = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME)
	if existing then
		return existing :: Folder
	end
	local created = Instance.new("Folder")
	created.Name = FOLDER_NAME
	created.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	return created
end

local function remote(name: string, className: "RemoteEvent" | "RemoteFunction"): Instance
	local root = folder()
	local existing = root:FindFirstChild(name)
	if existing then
		return existing
	end
	if RunService:IsClient() then
		return root:WaitForChild(name)
	end
	local created = Instance.new(className)
	created.Name = name
	created.Parent = root
	return created
end

type Validator = (...any) -> boolean

local buckets: { [Player]: { count: number, resetAt: number } } = {}

local function allowed(player: Player): boolean
	local now = os.clock()
	local bucket = buckets[player]
	if not bucket or now >= bucket.resetAt then
		bucket = { count = 0, resetAt = now + 1 }
		buckets[player] = bucket
	end
	bucket.count += 1
	return bucket.count <= RATE_LIMIT_PER_SECOND
end

if RunService:IsServer() then
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		buckets[player] = nil
	end)
end

-- Server: RemoteBus.OnEvent("Jump", validator, function(player, ...) end)
function RemoteBus.OnEvent(name: string, validator: Validator?, handler: (Player, ...any) -> ()): RBXScriptConnection
	local event = remote(name, "RemoteEvent") :: RemoteEvent
	return event.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, ...)
		if not allowed(player) then
			return
		end
		if validator and not validator(...) then
			warn(("[RemoteBus] %s sent an invalid %s payload"):format(player.Name, name))
			return
		end
		handler(player, ...)
	end)
end

-- Server: RemoteBus.OnInvoke("GetProfile", validator, function(player, ...) return ... end)
function RemoteBus.OnInvoke(name: string, validator: Validator?, handler: (Player, ...any) -> ...any)
	local fn = remote(name, "RemoteFunction") :: RemoteFunction
	fn.OnServerInvoke = function(player, ...)
		if not allowed(player) then
			return nil
		end
		if validator and not validator(...) then
			return nil
		end
		return handler(player, ...)
	end
end

function RemoteBus.FireClient(name: string, player: Player, ...: any)
	(remote(name, "RemoteEvent") :: RemoteEvent):FireClient(player, ...)
end

function RemoteBus.FireAllClients(name: string, ...: any)
	(remote(name, "RemoteEvent") :: RemoteEvent):FireAllClients(...)
end

-- Client helpers
function RemoteBus.Fire(name: string, ...: any)
	(remote(name, "RemoteEvent") :: RemoteEvent):FireServer(...)
end

function RemoteBus.Invoke(name: string, ...: any): ...any
	return (remote(name, "RemoteFunction") :: RemoteFunction):InvokeServer(...)
end

function RemoteBus.OnClientEvent(name: string, handler: (...any) -> ()): RBXScriptConnection
	return (remote(name, "RemoteEvent") :: RemoteEvent).OnClientEvent:Connect(handler)
end

return RemoteBus

templates.name: Server bootstrap
templates.description: Loads every service ModuleScript, runs Init/Start with isolated error handling and timing output.
templates.content:
--!strict
-- ServerBootstrap.server.lua
-- Place in ServerScriptService. Loads every ModuleScript under
-- ServerScriptService/Services in dependency-safe order, calls :Init() then
-- :Start() and reports failures without taking the whole server down.

local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local SERVICES_FOLDER = ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("Services", 10)
local started = os.clock()

type Service = {
	Name: string,
	Init: ((self: Service) -> ())?,
	Start: ((self: Service) -> ())?,
}

local services: { Service } = {}

local function load(module: ModuleScript)
	local ok, result = pcall(require, module)
	if not ok then
		warn(("[Bootstrap] failed to require %s: %s"):format(module:GetFullName(), tostring(result)))
		return
	end
	if typeof(result) ~= "table" then
		warn(("[Bootstrap] %s did not return a table"):format(module:GetFullName()))
		return
	end
	result.Name = result.Name or module.Name
	table.insert(services, result)
end

if SERVICES_FOLDER then
	for _, child in SERVICES_FOLDER:GetDescendants() do
		if child:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			load(child)
		end
	end
end

table.sort(services, function(a, b)
	return a.Name < b.Name
end)

for _, service in services do
	if service.Init then
		local ok, err = pcall(service.Init, service)
		if not ok then
			warn(("[Bootstrap] %s:Init failed: %s"):format(service.Name, tostring(err)))
		end
	end
end

for _, service in services do
	if service.Start then
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, err = pcall(service.Start, service)
			if not ok then
				warn(("[Bootstrap] %s:Start failed: %s"):format(service.Name, tostring(err)))
			end
		end)
	end
end

print(("[Bootstrap] %d service(s) ready in %.1f ms (%s)"):format(
	#services,
	(os.clock() - started) * 1000,
	RunService:IsStudio() and "Studio" or "Live"
))

templates.name: State machine
templates.description: Allocation-free finite state machine for NPCs, UI flows and match phases with a Changed signal.
templates.content:
--!strict
-- StateMachine.lua (ModuleScript, ReplicatedStorage/Shared)
-- Small, allocation-free finite state machine for NPCs, UI flows and
-- match phases. States are tables with optional Enter / Update / Exit.

export type State<T> = {
	Enter: ((context: T, from: string?) -> ())?,
	Update: ((context: T, dt: number) -> string?)?,
	Exit: ((context: T, to: string) -> ())?,
}

export type Machine<T> = {
	Current: string?,
	Context: T,
	States: { [string]: State<T> },
	Changed: RBXScriptSignal,
	Transition: (self: Machine<T>, to: string) -> (),
	Update: (self: Machine<T>, dt: number) -> (),
	Destroy: (self: Machine<T>) -> (),
}

local StateMachine = {}
StateMachine.__index = StateMachine

function StateMachine.new<T>(context: T, states: { [string]: State<T> }, initial: string): Machine<T>
	local event = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
	local self = setmetatable({
		Current = nil,
		Context = context,
		States = states,
		Changed = event.Event,
		_event = event,
	}, StateMachine) :: any
	self:Transition(initial)
	return self
end

function StateMachine:Transition(to: string)
	local nextState = self.States[to]
	assert(nextState, ("[StateMachine] unknown state '%s'"):format(to))
	local from = self.Current
	if from == to then
		return
	end
	local current = from and self.States[from]
	if current and current.Exit then
		current.Exit(self.Context, to)
	end
	self.Current = to
	if nextState.Enter then
		nextState.Enter(self.Context, from)
	end
	self._event:Fire(from, to)
end

function StateMachine:Update(dt: number)
	local state = self.Current and self.States[self.Current]
	if state and state.Update then
		local nextName = state.Update(self.Context, dt)
		if nextName then
			self:Transition(nextName)
		end
	end
end

function StateMachine:Destroy()
	self._event:Destroy()
	table.clear(self)
end

return StateMachine
